output.answer:
The five artists with the most albums are:
1. Iron Maiden — 21 albums
2. Led Zeppelin — 14 albums
3. Deep Purple — 11 albums
4. Metallica — 10 albums
5. U2 — 10 albums

Notes: Metallica and U2 are tied with 10 albums each; I listed both. Counts come directly from the Album table grouped by Artist.
sql_used:
SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, COUNT(a.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album a USING (ArtistId)
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.Name ASC;

SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, COUNT(a.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album a USING (ArtistId)
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.Name ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(a.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album a USING (ArtistId)
GROUP BY ar.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.Name ASC
LIMIT 10;
